Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the slaughter, preparation, and sale of certain poultry.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to poultry; amending RCW 69.07.100; adding a newsection to chapter 43.20 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 16.49RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 69.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Rules adopted by the state board of health, the department ofhealth, or a local health jurisdiction, as defined in RCW 43.70.575,regulating food or food service establishments do not apply to theslaughter and preparation of one thousand or fewer poultry animals ina calendar year by the agricultural producer of the poultry for thesale of the whole or cutup raw poultry by the producer directly toretail customers, or to such sale. The state board of health, thedepartment of health, or a local health jurisdiction, as defined in RCW43.70.575, shall not apply such rules directly or indirectly to such anactivity or sale.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.49 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to the slaughter and preparation of onethousand or fewer poultry animals in a calendar year by theagricultural producer of the poultry for the sale of the whole or cutup raw poultry by the producer directly to retail customers or to sucha sale.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.07.100 and 2002 c 301 s 10 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter shall not apply toestablishments issued a permit or licensed under the provisions of: (((1))) (a) Chapter 69.25 RCW, the Washington wholesome eggs andegg products act; (((2))) (b) Chapter 69.28 RCW, the Washington state honey act; (((3))) (c) Chapter 16.49 RCW, the meat inspection act; (((4))) (d) Chapter 77.65 RCW, relating to the direct retailendorsement for wildcaught seafood; (((5))) (e) Title 66 RCW, relating to alcoholic beverage control;and (((6))) (f) Chapter 69.30 RCW, the sanitary control of shellfishact. However, if any such establishments process foods notspecifically provided for in the above entitled acts, suchestablishments shall be subject to the provisions of this chapter. (2) The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to: (a) Restaurants or food service establishments; and (b) The slaughter and preparation of one thousand or fewer poultryanimals in a calendar year by the agricultural producer of the poultryfor the sale of the whole or cutup raw poultry by the producerdirectly to retail customers or to such a sale.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to the slaughter and preparation of onethousand or fewer poultry animals in a calendar year by theagricultural producer of the poultry for the sale of the whole or cutup raw poultry by the producer directly to retail customers, or to sucha sale.
